title: 2-D Convolution Backward
signature: def conv2d_backward(dout, x, w, stride=1, pad=0) -> tuple
hints: db is the easy one: sum dout over every axis except the filter axis.
In the forward pass, offset (i, j) contributed einsum('nchw,fc->nfhw', win_ij, w[:, :, i, j]). Differentiate that one term.
dw[:, :, i, j] = einsum('nfhw,nchw->fc', dout, win_ij). The gradient for win_ij is einsum('nfhw,fc->nchw', dout, w[:, :, i, j]).
Windows overlap when stride < kernel size, so ADD each slice's gradient into a padded dx buffer, then crop the padding off. Careful: xp[pad:-pad] is empty when pad = 0.
